source_snapshot.items: Configuring BMC Network through IPMI for dhcp(IB)
source_snapshot.procedure: Through in-band IPMI set the selected channel address source to DHCP; eth0/eth1 are described as channels 1/2.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command returns no error and complete `lan print` values are correct.
source_snapshot.script: No script; 5 attended and 5 machine minutes; setup requests clearing logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; assumes channel 1, uses command-line credentials and verifies only IP source/address while warning a failed lease may leave stale reachability.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at HIGH risk; resolve channel/MAC, approved DHCP scope/reservation, full baseline, alternate recovery, bounded lease discovery, complete post-state and rollback.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly identifies lease failure but does not bind the DHCP lease to BMC MAC or validate scope, VLAN, gateway, full state and independent recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires DHCP/IPAM ownership and MAC-keyed lease evidence rather than treating `ipsrc dhcp` acknowledgement as completion.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: DHCP success has two stages: the BMC accepts DHCP mode, then the approved server assigns the intended lease on the intended network. Source-mode readback without MAC/lease/server evidence can pass even when the BMC has no usable address or receives an unauthorized address.

original_test_intent: Switch one verified BMC interface to DHCP through in-band IPMI and prove it obtains the approved MAC-bound network configuration and remains reachable.
original_method: Bind IPMI channel to port/MAC/VLAN, capture full baseline, verify the approved DHCP scope/reservation and alternate recovery, set only that channel to DHCP, observe bounded discover/offer/lease behavior, reconnect by the assigned address, compare complete LAN state and restore the baseline when required.
manual_activity: The owner supplies exact channel/MAC and approved DHCP scope/reservation, approves disconnect and final mode; an operator maintains independent console or OOB recovery and can restore the baseline if no valid lease appears.
required_inputs: Meaning of IB and supported transport
VLAN, route, firewall and conflict validation
safety_requirements: Expect address change and session loss
Stop on no lease, wrong lease, conflict or wrong VLAN
Rollback under owner direction without automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture complete post-state and reconnect identity
Restore if required and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Direct rollback on failure or unexpected address

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `lan set <channel> ipsrc dhcp` matches the mutation, but channel 1 is assumed, filtered `lan print` omits gateway/VLAN/MAC/auth fields and no approved DHCP lease is proven.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through verified in-band IPMI, set the mapped channel to DHCP only after confirming the MAC-bound approved scope, then collect complete `lan print`, server lease evidence and identity-bound reconnect or rollback.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 5/5-minute single-source-mode change remains; channel and DHCP environment stay unresolved until owner input and no diagnostic evidence is cleared.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transaction ledger containing channel/port/MAC identity, complete baseline, DHCP scope/reservation, source-mode write, discover/lease timeline, full assigned configuration, reconnect identity and rollback/retention result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative DHCP-server evidence and full network identity instead of assuming a source flag and address prove success.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: `IP Address Source : DHCP` can coexist with a stale, zero, link-local or unintended lease and does not prove route reachability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Lease acquisition and BMC application timing are firmware/network-dependent; polling must be bounded and old-address reachability must not be mistaken for a valid new lease.

project_override_considerations: The Project must state the approved DHCP server/scope, expected reservation behavior and whether the test leaves DHCP enabled. Static restoration is a controlled rollback, not an assumed automatic cleanup.
expected_evidence: Approval, exact channel/port/MAC/VLAN and DHCP reservation
Complete baseline and DHCP service validation
Redacted source-mode write and lease timeline
DHCP server lease plus complete post-LAN state
New-address reachability with target identity and alternate-path evidence
Rollback or retained-mode proof, BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target DHCP mode on one BMC interface. Blank channel and network details are required execution inputs, not competing source intentions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Channel mapping, DHCP scope and recovery are normal owner/package inputs. Execution blocks if no approved lease path or independent recovery exists.

review_improvement: Separates accepting DHCP mode from actually obtaining the approved lease and prevents an assumed channel or stale address from producing a false pass.
independent_technical_reasoning: A DHCP transition may leave the previous address visible until renewal or may acquire a lease on an unintended VLAN. Correlating BMC MAC, server-side lease and complete BMC LAN state is required to prove the right interface obtained the right configuration. An in-band control path permits observation even while network reachability moves.
